_about: Every public-domain Richard Baxter (1615-1691) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is Orme's edition of the Practical Works (London, 1830), 23 volumes, vol. 1 being William Orme's Life (Orme d. 1830). All 23 volumes are held as raw IA OCR, unconverted (the Edwards precedent); no single scan series is complete, so the set mixes Toronto, other library and Google/BSB scans, and each volume number was read off the title-page OCR. Every CCEL Baxter title is held as clean ThML, and Gutenberg's four-part Christian Directory (rights lines checked by the fetcher). Modern reprints are excluded. Extended 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Logos author list): the works Orme's Practical Works leaves out, from first or early printings of 1649 to 1696: Reliquiae Baxterianae (his autobiography, 1696), Catholick Theology (1675), the Aphorisms of Justification and the later justification disputes (Four Disputations, Of Saving Faith, A Treatise of Justifying Righteousness, Imputative Righteousness, An End of Doctrinal Controversies), the Paraphrase on the New Testament (1685), A Holy Commonwealth, The Certainty of the World of Spirits, and his writings on infant baptism, church government, concord, nonconformity and Popery.
